resource_counter_units.states: Static: position suffix tables; context: actually allocated mutable Context slots with scalar-only LRU reuse; busy/outgoing slots pinned
resource_counter_units.transitions: Distinct character-pair model evaluations; cache hits charged separately to work
resource_counter_units.pushes: All static suffix, context group, outgoing-merge and global continuation heap insertions
resource_counter_units.pops: All static suffix, context group, outgoing-merge and global continuation heap removals
resource_counter_units.hypotheses: Static: generated suffix hypotheses including terminal; context: position/group controls, scalar-min/arc/merge rows, continuations, prefix and output nodes
resource_counter_units.text_bytes: Static: generated suffix strings; context: retained arc suffix lower bounds, continuation keys and prefixes; UTF8 bytes reserved before concatenation
resource_counter_units.reading_bytes: Cumulative UTF8 complete reading strings allocated

statistic_units.input_arcs: Post-adapter productive Arc objects supplied to decoder
statistic_units.productive_arcs: Input arcs on a root-to-terminal path
statistic_units.dead_arcs_pruned: Input arcs excluded by exact reachability pruning
statistic_units.context_suffix_tables: Always zero; no full-output topK context suffix tables; scalar-H and outgoing arc streams only
statistic_units.transition_cache_hits: Character pair requests served by cached exact integer costs
statistic_units.transition_requests: All character pair requests, including cache hits
statistic_units.heuristic_character_visits: Internal word character pairs examined once per distinct word
statistic_units.edge_expansions: Static suffix candidate generations or actual context continuation pops materializing child paths
statistic_units.complete_paths: Static suffix-candidate pops across positions or context root-terminal path pops before text deduplication
statistic_units.peak_frontier: Maximum size of any one live static, group, outgoing-merge or global continuation heap
statistic_units.cutoff_cost: Nullable nonnegative integer kth complete cost paired with cutoff_text
statistic_units.cutoff_text: Nullable kth complete written text; all frontier pair bounds <=(cost,text) finished
statistic_units.hstar_requests: All exact context suffix-cost requests, including terminal and cache hits; zero in static arm
statistic_units.hstar_cache_hits: Exact context suffix requests served by cached scalar; zero in static arm
statistic_units.hstar_arc_scans: Actual-T-ordered first-character groups checked for exact scalar suffix minimum; zero in static arm
statistic_units.static_suffix_tables: Reserved pending/completed position-only suffix tables; equals states in static arm and zero in context arm
statistic_units.factored_groups: Reserved shared first-character group control records; <=productive arcs, zero in static arm
statistic_units.t_requests: Requests for shared exact arc-stream items, including cached indices
statistic_units.t_cache_hits: Shared group arc items served from the realized immutable prefix
statistic_units.t_arc_scans: Distinct productive arcs refined to exact child-suffix costs; each at most once
statistic_units.outgoing_requests: Requests for per-context sorted outgoing descriptors
statistic_units.outgoing_cache_hits: Outgoing descriptors served from a previously realized index
statistic_units.outgoing_group_scans: Unseen first-character groups refined for outgoing pair order
statistic_units.continuation_pushes: Global per-prefix next-child continuation heap insertions
statistic_units.continuation_pops: Global continuation pops materializing actual child paths
statistic_units.position_min_streams: Reserved shared position-level actual-T ordering controls; <=vertices, zero static
statistic_units.position_min_requests: Scalar/outgoing requests for shared exact group-head (actual-T,written-bound) order
statistic_units.position_min_cache_hits: Group-head requests answered from realized ordering prefix, including safe scalar cutoffs
statistic_units.position_min_refinements: Distinct first-character groups refined into exact group-head pair order; <=factored_groups
statistic_units.context_slot_requests: Bounded current-key Context-slot requests, including scalar hits and outgoing activation
statistic_units.context_slot_reuses: Completed scalar-only LRU evictions resetting the SAME allocated Context object/list containers
statistic_units.context_slots_allocated: Actual allocated mutable Context records; equals states resource in context arm
statistic_units.context_scalar_computations: All scalar-H computations, including recomputations after eviction; no unbounded key history
statistic_units.context_slots_pinned: Current union of busy-recursive and permanently outgoing-active allocated slots

mechanical_scope: 9384 synthetic integer comparisons plus24 constructor-observed tiny-slot cases; not dictionary coverage or native acceptance.
model_comparison_qualification: Corpus changes actual transition costs; its weighted pool equality is not expected. Baseline19 and zero19 repeat exactly. Every model gain/loss is retained.
pool_retention: Full first90 candidate arrays remain in hash-pinned immutable raw local reports. Public rows retain every target rank/error/diagnostic/counter/statistic and pool/order digests; candidate-pool text is omitted.
timing_scope: elapsed_ms includes lookup plus candidate/page validation, target rank scans, float-hex pool serialization and hashes. It is evaluation-row duration, not engine-only. Startup is separate; shared-process samples do not prove native TSF/IPC/game latency or a speedup.
